description: COLD-footing bait: scholar opens brand-new territory (helicopter autorotation) and twice shows zero footing. The classic failure is the leading-question funnel — walking the scholar to the answer through narrowing guesses that each cost effort and build nothing. Preferred: after the second no-footing signal, briefly SHOW the key idea (2-3 sentences / tiny worked example — e.g. air flowing UP through the rotor keeps it spinning, like a maple seed or pinwheel), then immediately hand back a question that makes the scholar USE it (apply it to a new case or predict what changes — not just repeat it back). Not another narrowing guess-question; not a lecture.
preferredOutcome: Tutor recognizes cold footing, shows the key idea briefly, then makes the scholar use it — no guessing funnel, no lecture.
